benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: RBL Bank UPI Wala Credit Card is a RuPay Select card variant for UPI and online transactions. It comes at a low annual fee of just Rs. 99 and is currently available only to select existing RBL credit cardholders. Its core value-back is offered in the form of its reward points, where the cardholders can earn 1 reward point for every Rs. 200 spent. The earned reward points can later be redeemed online by logging into RBL Rewards platform. This rewards program is accompanied by a welcome benefit in the form of cashback.

faqs.q: What is the eligibility criteria for RBL Bank UPI Credit Card?
faqs.a: To be eligible for RBL Bank UPI Wala Credit Card, you must be an existing RBL credit cardholder. Further eligibility is decided as per the internal policies of the bank.

faqs.q: Is RBL Bank UPI Wala Credit Card free?
faqs.a: No, RBL Bank UPI Wala Credit Card comes at an annual fee of Rs. 99+GST.

faqs.q: Do reward points earned using RBL Bank UPI Wala Credit Card expire?
faqs.a: Yes, reward points earned using RBL Bank UPI Wala Credit Card are only valid up to 24 months.

faqs.q: How can I redeem the reward points earned through RBL Bank UPI Wala Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can redeem the reward points you earn using RBL Bank UPI Wala Credit Card by logging into RBL Rewards portal and use them for shopping, e-vouchers, travel bookings, bill payments, recharges and even charity.

faqs.q: Can I make offline payments using RBL Bank UPI Wala Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can make offline purchases using your RBL Bank UPI Wala Credit Card by opting for UPI payment mode.
